metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2025-62593: Ray-Project Ray contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow remote code execution. Developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed to this vulnerability exploitable through Firefox and Safari.. Product: Ray
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2025-62593" or RuleName has "CVE-2025-62593" or ProcessName has "CVE-2025-62593" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-REMOTE-CODE-EXECUTION-010
